reason: The README describes a DSH Web side panel whose primary user-facing purpose is workspace navigation and review, combining file browsing, terminal access, and Git change inspection.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧提供工作区面板，集成文件浏览与编辑、终端命令执行以及 Git 变更审查。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH Web side panel for browsing and editing workspace files, running terminal commands, and reviewing Git changes.

capabilities: Provides a DSH Web right-side workspace panel
Reads and edits text files within configured size limits
Runs commands in the current workspace terminal
Reviews working-tree and staged Git changes
Opens files from session links for review
